artists.name: Marlowe & the Static
artists.bio: Guitars that glow like the last light on a mountain road. Marlowe & the Static turn small-town stories into widescreen indie rock, equal parts restless energy and slow-burning warmth. Their new live set follows the thread of After the Afterglow: finding a little light in the places you least expect.

artists.name: VEXA
artists.bio: A late-night transmission from somewhere between the dance floor and a daydream. VEXA builds immersive live electronic sets from analog synths, fractured vocals, and bass you can feel in your ribs. Between Frequencies is a room-filling journey, designed to be experienced together.

artists.name: Saint Juniper
artists.bio: Songs that feel like letters from an old friend. Saint Juniper pairs fingerpicked guitar with close harmonies and the kind of storytelling that makes a crowded room fall quiet. The Long Way Home brings new songs, familiar favorites, and a few stories from the road.

artists.name: The Velvet Hours
artists.bio: Deep grooves. Patient melodies. Nothing rushed. The Velvet Hours bring the warmth of classic soul into the present, with a live rhythm section that knows exactly when to leave space. In Good Time is their invitation to put the phone away and stay a little longer.

artists.name: Iron Pines
artists.bio: Heavy riffs with roots that run deep. Iron Pines channel Appalachian atmosphere into a thunderous live show, moving from spacious passages to walls of sound. Bring ear protection and make room at the front.

artists.name: Cassidy Rowe
artists.bio: Big-hearted pop for the drive home with the windows down. Cassidy Rowe writes candid songs about growing up, moving on, and starting over. Everything in Color brings those stories to life with a full band and a chorus for everyone in the room.

venues.name: Lincoln Theatre
venues.description: An intimate downtown room where a great night can start with a new discovery. Our sample program imagines guitar bands, soulful late sets, and artists on the way up.

venues.name: Cat’s Cradle
venues.description: A room for getting close to the music. This sample lineup pairs intimate songwriting nights with expansive indie rock and plenty of discoveries in between.
venues.accessibility: Please confirm specific accessibility arrangements directly with the venue before booking.
venues.parking: Explore public parking in downtown Carrboro and check posted restrictions.

venues.name: Motorco Music Hall
venues.description: Make a night of it in Durham. Our demo calendar brings together adventurous electronic sets, local soul, and bands worth catching before everyone else does.
venues.accessibility: Ask the venue about step-free access, accessible restrooms, and viewing arrangements.
venues.parking: Allow time to find parking around the Central Park district.

venues.name: The Ritz
venues.description: A bigger room for a bigger night. Discover our imagined mix of touring pop, heavier guitars, and electronic live sets.
venues.accessibility: Contact the venue for current accessibility information and seating options.
venues.parking: Review the venue’s current travel and parking guidance before arrival.

venues.name: DPAC
venues.description: An evening built around the performance. Our demo selection imagines acoustic storytellers and rich, full-band soul in a seated theatre setting.
venues.accessibility: Check with the venue for accessible seats, assisted listening, and other accommodations.
venues.parking: Check downtown Durham garage availability and event pricing.

venues.name: The Foundry Hall
venues.vibe: A new home for after hours.
venues.description: Old brick. New noise. A former industrial space reimagined as a home for live music, with a close-to-the-stage floor, a listening lounge, and room for the unexpected. Join us for a first look, a local lineup, and the first of many late nights.
venues.accessibility: Our fictional venue is designed with step-free entry and an accessible viewing area.
venues.parking: The fictional venue is in the Warehouse District. A precise address will be added before a real opening.
